> _This was generated by AI._

### Steps to reproduce

1. Inspect Hemiciclo's Repo Canon v0.27.0 / CLI 11.0.1 factory adoption for #29.
2. Compare the installed `.agents/skills/code-review/ownership-facts.mjs` with the Repo Canon block in `.gitattributes`.
3. Run `git check-attr linguist-vendored -- .agents/skills/code-review/ownership-facts.mjs`.

### Expected behavior

The installed runtime file is marked `linguist-vendored` under the installed git-attributes rules.

### Actual behavior

Observed in the adoption checkout: the attribute is `unspecified`; the block omits this newly installed skill's runtime. Other inventoried installed runtimes report `set`. The launch explicitly routes this low gap as a finding and forbids fixing it in the adoption PR. This is a local attribute observation, not a claim about the hosted language bar after merge.

### Environment

Hemiciclo, Repo Canon v0.27.0, factory profile, Repository Standards CLI 11.0.1.

### Additional context

Filing run: https://github.com/lutzseverino/hemiciclo/issues/29. The source guidance omission is already tracked in https://github.com/lutzseverino/repo-canon/issues/994; this issue tracks Hemiciclo's own correction outside the adoption PR.
